Cadastral map showing landholdings in central Washington with owners' names.

Cadastral map showing landholdings in central Washington with owners' names. Includes text. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy 1 soiled, fold-lined, taped, and mounted on cloth backing. LC copy 2 laminated and mounted on cloth backing. LC copy 2 annotated in pencil, ink, and watercolor to show tract boundaries and buildings. 2 copies DCP
